Instructions
1. Classes will remain suspended on examination days. No quiz, presentation etc. to be held during examination.
2. Check the exam timetable carefully; make sure you know the time and locations of your exams.
3. Examinations will be conducted during the allocated times shown in the examination timetable.
4. Arrive at examination venue before the start of the examination.
5. You may not be admitted for the examination after the commencement of the examination.
6. Before entering the examination hall, check yourself to ensure that you do not possess mobile phones, 
programmable calculators, electronic gadgets, any material notes pertaining to the examination etc.
7. Do not bring any unauthorized material (e.g. written notes, notes in dictionaries, paper any sticky tape eraser, 
electronic devices etc.).
8. Exchange of pens, pencil, rubber etc. will not be allowed in the examination hall.
9. Do not use unfair means during examinations. If a student is found to have adopted or suspected of adopting 
unfair means during or after the examination, the action shall be taken by the institute guideline/provisions to 
uphold the sanctity and integrity of the examination system and credibility of the institute.
10. Mobile phone and smart watch will not be allowed inside the examination halls (even in off condition). 
Students carrying a mobile phone will be debarred from writing the examination and mobile phone will be 
confiscated and retained for I nvestigations of possible violation of regulations.
11. Ensure that you use the washroom before arriving for your exam as you will not be permitted to leave during 
the exam.
12. All students are expected to behave responsibly and honestly with the invigilators or staff. In case any 
objectionable behavior of any student reported by the invigilator, necessary disciplinary action will be initiated.
